answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using proof-of-space-time. Agents commit persistent disk sectors organized in a rigid marble storage layout, answering periodic audits across a spiral verification pipeline. Validators query a shifting dune of pseudo-random challenge nonces to confirm sustained sector retention, forcing attackers to dedicate physical drive capacity per active identity. However, this design favors enterprise storage farms and accelerates hardware wear on flash memory.
